AppendixInfoChange.description: One changed field, old → new, as text in the invariant formats of AppendixInfoDraft.

AppendixInfoDraft.description: Requested new value of a contract field (amount: invariant number, date: yyyy-MM-dd, empty = remove).

ArchiveFileDto.description: A downloadable file of the dossier; string ArchiveFileDto.Id is an opaque token valid only inside its contract's tree.

AssigneeType.description: How the step's actor is determined.

ContractActionsDto.description: What the caller may do on the contract right now (drives the buttons of the detail screen).

ContractHistoryEntryDto.description:
One line of the contract "Lịch sử" tab (spec §9.1-5): an audit entry of the contract, one of its documents or
appendices. `Subject` is the audited type (Contract, ContractAppendix, Document); `Details` the JSON of the
change or business action.

ContractInfoField.description: Contract fields a "thay đổi thông tin" appendix may change (spec §5 "nội dung thay đổi có cấu trúc").

ContractLineRequest.description: A goods line: an existing item (bid item or catalog item) or a new item typed in (ngoài thầu).

ContractStatus.description: Contract lifecycle (spec §5.3). Signing states mirror the active step of the contract workflow.

DiffLine.description: One paragraph of a comparison: kept, only in the newer version, or only in the older one.

DocumentCompareDto.description: Result of comparing two versions of a document (spec §9.1-6 "so sánh phiên bản").

DocxRevision.description: One tracked change (Track Changes) in a DOCX, as shown in the "thay đổi của NCC" list.

HisInvoicePayload.description: Hóa đơn kèm phiếu (optional: the supplier may add it later on the portal).

HisReceiptPayload.description:
Phiếu nhập kho / hoàn trả as sent by the HIS (spec §6.4 B1, docs/HIS_INTEGRATION.md). Linked to a contract by
(BidDecisionNumber + SupplierTaxCode); idempotent by string HisReceiptPayload.HisReceiptId.

IntegrityIssue.description: Một tệp không đạt khi kiểm tra toàn vẹn: mất trên kho lưu trữ hoặc SHA-256 khác giá trị đã lưu.

ItemImportKind.description: Which Excel import template a category uses (spec §10 items 1–2).

ItemSource.description: Where an item record came from (spec §9.1-4 "xem nguồn").

LoginResult.description: Result of a login step. Either tokens are issued, or a 2FA challenge must be answered.

OrganizationCertificateDto.description: The hospital certificate used for "đóng dấu điện tử" (spec §8), shown on the organisation page.

ParsedInvoiceDto.description: Kết quả đọc file XML hóa đơn điện tử (điền sẵn form).

PaymentRecordStatus.description: Trạng thái chung của biên bản nghiệm thu / 08a / thanh lý (theo luồng ký).

ProcurementDomain.description: Mảng phụ trách — groups items/contracts for scoping and approval routing.

ProposalCandidateDto.description: A contract item that can be proposed, with its HIS stock movement for the period.

SaveReceiptRequest.description: Phiếu lập trên cổng (Portal) hoặc phiếu ảo xác nhận khối lượng (Virtual = true).

SigningMode.description: How a provider produces the signature (spec §8.1).

TemplateKind.description: Which data model a template is rendered with (decides the valid placeholders).

WorkflowActionType.description: What a workflow step asks the assignee to do (spec §5.7).

WorkflowGateDto.description: Business precondition on the caller's active step (e.g. receipt validation): blocked, or a reason is required.
